name: Segment by Points or Box
description: Cuts one object out of a picture as a mask, from points to include or leave out and/or a box. SAM 2.1 (code and checkpoints Apache-2.0, github.com/facebookresearch/sam2; the ONNX export is by vietanhdev, Apache-2.0) through ONNX Runtime (MIT), on the CPU or an NVIDIA GPU, in the pack's own Python environment. Nothing is bundled: the model is downloaded from the model picker after a question that names its licence.

setup.description: Create the pack's Python environment (ONNX Runtime for the CPU, NumPy, Pillow) in its folder; needs uv and the network.
